scope: Deliver cohesive local-first Go vertical slices for phases 1-5 on top of merged Phase 0: bounded context packing with progressive handles/session dedup/resource limits, typed deterministic code graph and bounded impact receipts, local token-savings ledger, provenance/session continuation and evidence/change-set workflow primitives, and canonical local HTTP/MCP adapters. Preserve default JSONL/CLI compatibility and defer hosted sync/tenancy/cloud phase 6.
non_goals: Phase 6 hosted sync, Postgres tenancy, remote overlays, cloud deployment
New external dependencies or hosted inference requirements
Replacing the existing Go workspace or direct JSONL protocol
Claiming full framework/tree-sitter/LSP/SCIP coverage beyond implemented fallbacks
risks: Public opt-in context fields and new HTTP/MCP surfaces can drift from JSONL behavior
Local source reads and request workers must remain path-safe and bounded
Typed graph snapshots must remain backward-compatible and deterministic
Session state and evidence must not persist raw source or secrets
Full repository tests may include unrelated platform-sensitive fixtures
